versions.changelog:
content-swarm v1.0.0

- Initial release of Content Swarm Skill, providing a full SOP for content production: topic selection, copywriting, cover design, and multi-platform distribution.
- Supports workflow integration for platforms including Xiaohongshu, WeChat Official Accounts, Douyin, Bilibili, and Kuaishou.
- Includes quality inspection checklist (accuracy, completeness, platform adaptation, brand tone, anti-AI detection).
- Integrates toolset: content-factory, anti-ai-slop, guizang-social-card, social-auto-upload, and knowledge-base retrieval.
- Built-in task/project file system and five-step closed-loop production process for streamlined content operations.
